summary.storyTitle: Story 6: Legacy File-Store Retirement And Compatibility Cleanup
summary.implementedScope: Hardened lh-context inspection so mixed legacy-JSON plus SQLite thread directories now prefer SQLite as authoritative, surface the selected backing in inspection/report outputs, and warn operators how to clean up split-brain risk; added Story 6 regressions for dual-source inspection and a source-truth grep guard over active runtime/maintenance/compact paths.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

evidence: Earlier verifier finding was addressed by quick-fix 007 and no longer appears as open in final verifier 006.
Final verifier 006 reports `npm run verify-all` passed cleanly.
Final verifier 006 marks the prior finding resolved and reports no open findings.

changedFiles.reason: Changed inspection loading to prefer SQLite in auto mode when both backings exist, avoid silent fallback to legacy JSON, and emit explicit dual-source cleanup warnings.
Surfaced the selected backing on summary, tokens, bands, and readiness inspection results.
Propagated backing metadata into post-compact report output.
Added backing lines to human-readable lh-context inspection/report output so operators can see source truth directly.
Extended public inspection/report result types with backing metadata.
Updated formatter fixtures for the new backing field.
Added Story 6 regression coverage proving inspection prefers SQLite and warns explicitly when stale legacy JSON shadows a live managed thread.
Added the root smoke/grep guard that blocks legacy managed JSON references in active runtime, maintenance, and compact entry paths.
